audience: product and engineering teams who plan and track work in Linear

useCases.title: List the issues assigned to you
useCases.text: The AI lists the issues assigned to the current user and groups them for you, for example by state. You see what is on your plate.

useCases.title: Find issues by team, state, assignee or title
useCases.text: The AI searches issues by a title text, team key, workflow state or assignee email. It can open one issue to read its description and recent comments.

useCases.title: Check project progress and target dates
useCases.text: The AI lists projects with their state, progress and target date. You see which projects are on track and which are late.

useCases.title: See the cycles (sprints) of a team
useCases.text: The AI lists cycles with number, name, start and end dates, for all teams or for one team. You see what is current and what is next.

useCases.title: Create an issue or add a comment to one
useCases.text: The AI creates an issue for a team with a title, description, priority and assignee, or posts a comment on an issue.
